page.title: Mirag — see the flow
page.heading: Mirag — see the flow
page.subtitle: Ask a question and watch **what the agent does step by step** before it answers.

legend.running: the step is in progress right now.
legend.completed: something **really ran** and finished well. Green is used for nothing else.
legend.warning: it finished, but with caveats worth reading.
legend.error: it failed, and the real output of the failure is below.
legend.unverified: the model produced something but **nobody has checked it yet**. Generating code is not the same as proving it works.
legend.simulated: a prepared demo answered: the model's decision came from a fixed script. What was retrieved, run and verified is real.
legend.no_model: offline and no demo matches: there is no model answer, and none is invented.

pipeline.name: Pipeline
pipeline.description: the production path: retrieves, generates, runs and verifies

architect.name: Architect
architect.description: 8 design phases (~10 min). Its phases do not have the same level of verification as Pipeline.

demos.label: Prepared demos
demos.unavailable: The prepared demos could not be loaded.

hints.project: a whole one, with a ZIP

cards.no_tools: It needed no tools: it answered from memory.
cards.empty_answer: The stream ended without an answer.
cards.code_below: The full code is not repeated here: it is below, in its own section, with tabs and download.

run.title: Ran the tests
run.not_executed_note: Without execution there is no evidence: whatever comes next is still a claim by the model, not a checked fact.
run.failed_exit: The command ended with an error.
run.markers_failed_note: The command exited without error, but the markers say otherwise. A test that prints FAIL and exits with 0 is a broken test: no CI would catch it.
run.passed: **{passed} of {total}** tests ran and are green.

proven.one: Proven: that test passes. Not proven: everything that test does not check.
proven.other: Proven: those {count} tests pass. Not proven: everything those tests do not check.

run.no_markers: The command finished without error, but the output has no `TEST:<id>:PASS` markers: there is no way to count what was really tested.

title.no_evidence: It ran, but with no evidence to count
title.failed: Code delivered — the tests did NOT pass
title.simulated: Green tests, but over a simulation
title.unknown: Code delivered, with no execution evidence

note.not_executed: The proposed command never got to run: {header}. The only thing that happened is that the model wrote this code; **nobody has checked it**.
note.no_evidence: The command finished without error and there are no test markers in the output: there is no way to know what was tested.
note.failed: You get it anyway so you can read it, but the execution does not back it.
note.simulated: **{technologies}** is replaced by an in-memory simulation: the tests prove the logic, **not** the real guarantees (constraints, isolation, locking).

passed_markers.one: **{count} marker** in the output, and it is PASS.
passed_markers.other: **{count} markers** in the output, all PASS.

note.passed: Green means the command really ran and its tests passed — not that the code is correct: it proves what those tests cover.
note.unknown: No step on this page ran anything: nobody has checked this code.

claim.title: MODEL CLAIM
claim.note: What the model **said** it would cover. Not a fact yet.

observed.title: OBSERVED
observed.note: What Mirag **saw** when running. Nobody gives an opinion.
observed.truncated: The output was truncated; the markers were kept.
observed.nothing: Nothing ran: there is nothing observed.

verified.title: VERIFIED
verified.note: Declared **and** proven by a real marker.
verified.simulated: Proven against a **simulation**, which is not the same thing:

not_verified.title: NOT VERIFIED
not_verified.note: Declared and **not** proven. It does not mean it is wrong: it means nobody tested it.

cost.demo: the model's decision came from the script of the demo {demo}. What was retrieved, run and verified did happen.
cost.no_model: there was no model decision. What was retrieved and the context are real.

warnings.skipped: The stages marked **skipped** did not run, and each one says why: most of them because nobody has measured yet that they help. That is deliberate — an unmeasured stage is born switched off.
warnings.green: Green here means **it ran and passed**, not **it is correct**. Passing some tests only proves what those tests cover: a *sequential* idempotency test passes even if the code has a race condition.
warnings.architect: **Experimental** mode: its phases do not go through the evidence discipline of the pipeline. What you see here is **what the model says**, not execution evidence.
warnings.claim: **The answer above carries a warning.** Mirag compared what the model claims with the markers the real execution produced, and they do not match ({status}). The model's text is left whole so you can judge it yourself.
warnings.label_not_run: **Careful with what you are about to read below.** The deliverable is labelled *passed*, but the executor observed {status} ({header}). A label is not an execution: nothing was proven.

title.incomplete: Project generated — the verification is not complete

note.integrity_error: There is no way to prove that the ZIP is the project that was verified, so it is not delivered. {reason}
note.ready: Its tests really ran and passed. Green means **it ran and passed**, not **it is correct**: it proves what those tests cover.
note.simulated: **The code was written by a fixed script, not by the model**: what was run, verified and packaged is real, but this does not show that the model generates a project like this.
note.incomplete: The ZIP is exactly what was generated, and that much can be stated. What cannot be said is that it works.

figures.integrity_ok: the ZIP is what was verified

project.no_download: No download: the artifact did not pass the integrity check.

integrity.no_junk_or_secret_names: no junk or secret file names

note.verified: The chain confirms the link: {call} returns this same wallet. It is not what Mirag says about itself, it is what the contract answers.
note.unverified: There is a stored agent ID, but the chain does not confirm the link: {reason}
note.unregistered: The wallet exists, but the agent is not registered in 8004 yet.
